title: Supergravity with Lagrange Multiplier Fields in 2 + 1 Dimensions
summary: We examine the first-order Einstein-Cartan (EC) action in 2+1 dimensions, including a cosmological term and its supersymmetric extension. In this setting the spin connection can be expressed as an axial vector, yielding an action that is bilinear in the quantum fields and allows quantization without background fields. From the complete set of first-class constraints, the associated gauge transformations all follow. These differ from the standard supersymmetric diffeomorphism and local Lorentz invariances. Using the closed gauge algebra, we construct the Faddeev-Popov-Nielsen path integral…
